text.p: Eurotronics Holdings Inc on Tuesday said it has named two directors to its board and terminated an agreement to acquire InterConnect West Inc.
Eurotronics named Paul Burke and Melvin Fields to its board, and immediately thereafter Mark Tolman, Nick Nickerson and Fred Muehlmann resigned from the board of directors.
InterConnect West, an operator of an Internet shopping mall called Access Market Square, was owned by Tolman.
The termination stems from delays Eurotronics has had closing the acquisition. The delays have impaired Eurotronics ability to obtain financing, it said in a statement.
Burke owns and operates Sun Fun Products Inc, a Florida maker and distributor of sun tanning products.
Eurotronics is currently in talks about a merger with Sun Fun. Terms of the transaction are being negotiated and were not disclosed.
